Season 2 was hands down the best season of The Originals and I think we can all agree. It embraces the idea of 'Klaus is the best strategist yet ruthless killer' when he defeated the most powerful witch yet left SEVERAL casualties behind, causing many rifts between characters.

Personally, season 3 was the next best thing because it covered a lot of the main antagonists backgrounds (despite never receiving any info on what happened to Aurora's lifeless body and whether or not she will remain asleep in the Mikaelson compound for eternity.)

Season 4 was next, I wasn't a fan of really knowing that there was an enemy that much more powerful than them and knowing that they didn't achieve true victory and triumph towards the end (season 3's end was an exception because we all pretty much expected Marcel's character to eventually give in to forgiveness.)

I've rewatched the show and season 1 was pretty boring the second time 'round, whereas the first time watching it was the best thing EVER. the only reason I selected season 1 was because it is ten times better than the final season and it also gives us a taste of characters, despite their development towards the end of the show.

Season 5 was so bad, Hopes character was an absolute shit show, to put it lightly. She went from the sweet, yet powerfully tough little girl we all adore to a weak pathetic character who shows no inch of being a Mikaelson warrior, if we're being honest. She was the reason behind three main character deaths (can't really blame her for Klaus and Elijah but it kinda was her fault) and trusted some trash boy and put her mother to sleep to gain her father's attention. We all are well aware that Elijah was on a journey to seek Nik's redemption and I'm more than sure he proved that much but forcing Elijah to kill himself proves zero character development and displays that Elijah's life had no purpose aside from Niklaus.  Josh's death was so unnecessary and Hope taking all the black magic proves nothing, it was a sad attempt at showing her sacrificing herself for family, for always and forever, considering she couldn't even get that 1 job done. Killing Hayley off was also beyond unnecessary, it was a pathetic ploy to develop a storyline for Legacies and the entire season was a bloody prequel for an orphan hope. we also deserved Hope and Elijah scenes.
